name: Burrito Bowl
summary: Rice, two kinds of beans, and corn in one bowl. Cheap, filling, and vegan.
instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions and set aside.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook 4–5 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic, chili powder, cumin, and paprika. Stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the diced tomatoes with their juice. Add the black beans, kidney beans, and corn.
Simmer uncovered over medium-low heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide the rice among four bowls and spoon the bean mixture over top.
Scatter the green onions over each bowl and serve.

glutenFree.notes: All ingredients are naturally gluten-free. If you use a pre-mixed taco or chili seasoning instead of individual spices, check the label for wheat-based fillers or anti-caking agents.

budgetNotes: Use whichever canned beans are cheapest that week — pinto, romano, or black-eyed peas all work.
A spoon of hot sauce or a squeeze of lime brightens it up if you have them.
Scales and reheats well. Keep components separate in the fridge for up to 4 days.
